benefits.title: A spot that is theirs
benefits.text: An enclosed cave gives a cat somewhere to tuck in that is not your chair. Some cats take to a covered bed quickly, others take their time.

benefits.title: Soft where it counts
benefits.text: A cushioned floor and plush trim around the entrance. The interior cushion detail is confirmed with the supplier before launch.

benefits.title: Looks like it belongs
benefits.text: Black-and-white cow print with small ears, horns and a pom-pom. A pet bed you do not have to hide when guests come over.

benefits.title: Simple to live with
benefits.text: Care instructions are published exactly as the supplier confirms them. We will not claim machine-washable until we know it is.

intro: Put it somewhere quiet, away from doors and foot traffic.
Leave it alone for a few days. Let your cat find it.
A familiar blanket or a treat inside can help, but do not place the cat in it.
Give it a couple of weeks before deciding.

faq.q: What if my cat doesn’t use it?
faq.a: Every cat has its own preferences, and no bed works for every cat. The best odds come from a quiet spot, a slow introduction and patience: see the four-step guide above. If it still is not working, our returns policy applies as published.

We publish the external size, the usable interior and the entrance measurements once the supplier confirms them, with a short guide for measuring your cat. Until then we do not claim a fit for any particular size of cat.
The approved cleaning method is published here as soon as the supplier confirms it. We will not claim a removable cover or machine-washability before that.
Construction and materials are listed here once confirmed, along with what we observe on the sample. No stability claims until then.

Our draft returns policy allows returns within 30 days for unused items in original condition, and damaged or incorrect items reported within 7 days of delivery. The final policy is confirmed at launch; the full draft is on the Shipping & Returns page.
